import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return
    coord = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(5):
            coord[i][j] = int(next(it))
    vect = [[[0]*5 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            for k in range(5):
                vect[i][j][k] = coord[j][k] - coord[i][k]
    good = [True]*n
    count = n
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if j != i:
                for k in range(n):
                    if k != j and k != i:
                        prod = 0
                        for m in range(5):
                            prod += vect[j][i][m] * vect[k][i][m]
                        if prod > 0 and good[i]:
                            good[i] = False
                            count -= 1
    print(count)
    for i in range(n):
        if good[i]:
            print(i+1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
